On Mon, Jun 14, 2027 at 4:27 PM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Priyom, can you validate the request IDs against the inference logs and confirm whether this is a model-level error (OOM/quant kernel) or a routing/fallback mismatch?

Checked the logs and tail of the serving runtime for the timeframe you sent. Initial findings:
- A subset of calls returned a 500 with kernel-assert in the quantized execution path (see excerpt).
- The failures cluster on requests with long prompt prefixes (~>8k tokens) that trigger a different kernel selection path we recently shipped for performance on polaris2b.
- Not all requests with long prefixes failed, suggesting a rare race condition in KV cache eviction + kernel swap which can surface as a timeout or 5xx.

Interim mitigation applied at 16:45 PT: automatic routing policy temporarily favors polaris2b-legacy (non-quantized) and disables the new kernel switch for sequences >6k tokens. This reduced error rate to baseline within ~6 minutes.

Next steps:
1) Produce a short RCA and timeline for the customer (I'll draft).
2) Patch the kernel selection guard and roll to a canary (expect ~4–6 hours).
3) Backfill missing observability for corner-case token-lengths.

Attachments: log_excerpt_polaris2b.txt

—Priyom

Subject: Polaris2B incident — preliminary RCA and next steps

Hi Sam — following up with a concise post-incident summary and next steps. Thanks again for rapid detection and for switching to the pinned variant while we investigated.

Summary (what happened)
- Timewindow: 2027-06-14 15:50–16:46 PT (peak errors between 15:52–16:02)
- Symptom: intermittent 500s and request timeouts for polaris2b inference requests
- Root cause: a race in the new kernel-selection path for quantized execution triggered by long-prefix (>~8k tokens) requests. Combined KV-cache eviction and kernel-swap produced a kernel-assert that propagated as a 500; in other cases it caused end-to-end timeouts.

Impact
- Northwind: ~1.3% session error rate during the window; ~18 support tickets; transient failures in card charge flows for a small subset of users.
- Scope: limited to polaris2b production variant with the new kernel selection enabled; polaris2b-legacy and other models were unaffected.

Mitigation taken
- Temporary routing favoring polaris2b-legacy and disabling kernel swap for sequences >6k tokens (applied at 16:45 PT) — reduced error rate to baseline within ~6 minutes.
- Hotfix plan: patch kernel-selection guard and deploy canary (ETA: 4–6 hours from report).

Follow-ups / timeline
- Today (Jun 15): Priyom to ship a guarded patch and roll a canary by EOD PT.
- Next 48 hours: full rollout after canary validation; add observability for token-length edge cases.
- Postmortem doc and public RCA (redacted) to be shared within 72 hours.

Attachments included for your review:
- polaris2b_rca_20270614.pdf (short RCA and timeline)
- polaris2b_request_ids.csv (sample request ids you provided)
- log_excerpt_polaris2b.txt (server log excerpt showing kernel-assert)
